name: @bussolabs/closeyourit-cli
description: CLI for CloseYourIt — manage org, errors, tokens and tickets with your user token

artifacts:source-maps.description: Upload and manage source maps without source contents

artifacts:proguard-maps.description: Upload and manage private ProGuard/R8 mappings

projects:settings.description: Per-project settings: log/analytics retention and feature flags

environments.description: Environments (production, staging, …) shared by projects, tokens and monitors

platforms.description: Platforms (devices/systems) your projects and tickets run on

errors.description: Error monitoring: list, show, triage, assign, merge/split, delete

errors:grouping-rules.description: Custom grouping rules: how a project bends the automatic error grouping

tokens:provisions.description: GitHub provisioning of an ingest token: status and retry (never the secret)

secrets.description: Encrypted environment variables and versioned secret files

secrets:assets.description: Encrypted secret files: upload, download, versions, delegation

personal.description: Personal (per-user) encrypted secrets for the current organization

shared.description: Organization-level shared secret variables, delegated to projects

vault.description: Vault review: the secret changes waiting for a second approval

vault:requests.description: Secret change requests: list, approve, reject (four-eyes, decided by a person)

tickets:dependencies.description: Ticket prerequisites: what has to be finished before a ticket can start

tickets:questions.description: Questions on a ticket: ask, answer, withdraw (they live apart from the discussion)

tickets:lease.description: Working lease on a ticket: claim, renew, release (one worker at a time)

milestones.description: Project milestones: dated goals a ticket can be assigned to

assistant.description: AI assistant that reads the data you can see and answers questions about it

puck.description: Your Puckies (AI coworkers): let them use this computer, one approved request at a time

assistant:conversations.description: Conversations with the assistant (list, open, read, delete)

ideas.description: Project ideas: propose, vote, comment, convert to ticket (AI draft)

coverage.description: Test coverage published by the CI (last snapshot per branch)

usage.description: Usage the product reported as actually executed (routes, jobs, custom keys)

vulnerabilities.description: Dependency vulnerabilities and runtime support: triage, ignore, promote to ticket

seo.description: SEO findings of the watched sites: triage, ignore, promote to ticket

seo-sites.description: Sites under SEO check: declare, configure, remove

alerts.description: Alert rules, external delivery channels and your own notifications

alerts:channels.description: External delivery channels for alerts (webhook, Telegram)

alerts:notifications.description: Your in-app notification inbox: list, mark read, delete

alerts:preferences.description: Your personal alert preferences, per organization

agents.description: Org automator tokens (cyi_a_) used to bootstrap an Agent Host

agents:tokens.description: The automator tokens themselves: create, list, revoke (the secret is shown only once)

servers:tokens.description: Fleet enrollment tokens (server agents authenticate with these)

monitors.description: Uptime monitors of a project: checks, public status page, incidents

monitors:announcements.description: Announcement banner shown on a monitor's public status page

monitors:incidents.description: Uptime incidents: group them and narrate them step by step

kb.description: Knowledge base: pages (notes/decisions/guides), semantic search and AI ask

kb:book.description: Knowledge books: ordered collections of pages (summary, add a page)

todos.description: Personal todo lists: items, sharing, completion

todos:items.description: Items of a todo list: add, list, update, delete

workload.description: Team workload actions (non-dev activities): participants, link or generate a ticket

workload:participant.description: People taking part in a workload action (members of its team)

analytics.description: Web analytics: stats, conversion goals, public share

analytics:goals.description: Conversion goals of a project: create, list, delete

uptime-groups.description: Uptime monitor groups (org-level) + public status page

guidance.description: Project guidance: effective references and procedures (resolved by the backend)

matrix.description: Product feature × platform matrix: categories, features, cells

matrix:categories.description: Feature groups (categories): how the rows of a product matrix are organized

matrix:features.description: Features: the rows of a product matrix

matrix:cells.description: Matrix cells: how far a feature is on a platform, and since which version

org.description: Organization settings, and switching between your organizations

members.description: Organization members: profile, role, access scope

invitations.description: Invitations to join the organization: create, resend, revoke

teams.description: Teams: people bundled with roles and a group/project scope

roles.description: RBAC roles: named bundles of permission keys

service-accounts.description: Service accounts (AI members, CLI-only) and their secret access

service-accounts:tokens.description: CLI tokens (cyi_u_) of a service account (the secret is shown only once)

artifacts:native-symbols.description: Upload and manage private native debug files

scripts.prepack: pnpm build && node scripts/generate-manifest.mjs && node scripts/generate-opencli.mjs
